text: dsh-assist 是面向 DSH Desktop 和 Web 的角色与记忆插件：它把角色设定和记忆加入系统提示，并提供工具管理角色、保存长期事实、按会话保存检查点、搜索记忆及恢复跨会话检查点。用户也可导入导出角色包，并明确开启闲置主动聊天；主动聊天支持空闲时间、冷却、安静时段和无人回应上限。适合希望在 Harness 会话中复用角色并保留连续性的用户。数据保存在本地 JSON 文件；主动聊天需在当前会话明确启用，调用所选模型并使用其正常额度。

dsh-assist adds personas and local memory to DSH Desktop and Web. Tools manage roles, save and search memories, and carry checkpoints across chats. Users can import or export role packs and enable idle follow-ups with quiet hours and cooldowns. Follow-ups use the selected model’s normal quota.

如何把一个会话的摘要带到另一个同角色会话？
I want reusable personas and persistent memory across my Harness chats.
Can my assistant check in after I have been idle, with quiet hours?
dsh-assist 的功能「角色与提示词」：插件将所选角色的人设、风格、记忆规则和可选问候语加入系统提示；每个会话可绑定角色，用户可切换。
dsh-assist 的功能「长期记忆」：用户可保存事实、偏好、决定或推断，并按关键词检索；记忆按角色共享，可修订已有条目。
dsh-assist 的功能「会话检查点」：用户可保存带有效期的当前会话摘要，并将同一角色另一会话中未过期的检查点显式恢复。
dsh-assist 的功能「闲置主动聊天」：用户在当前会话明确开启后，空闲达到设定时间时插件触发一条模型跟进；支持冷却、安静时段和无人回应上限。
dsh-assist 的功能「角色包导入导出」：CLI 可校验、预览或应用角色包，也可导出公开角色包或显式包含记忆的私人包。
dsh-assist 的使用须知：闲置主动聊天只在当前会话明确启用后运行；后端需保持运行，恢复触发会调用所选模型并消耗其正常用量。
如何让助手在会话间记住重要信息和偏好？
能不能在安静时段之外，等待一段时间后再主动跟进？
dsh-assist 提供工具 assist_list：List available dsh-assist roles.
dsh-assist 提供工具 assist_use：Bind this session to a role; use only after an explicit user request.
dsh-assist 提供工具 assist_memory_read：Read current-role memories and this session’s checkpoint.
dsh-assist 提供工具 assist_remember：Store a meaningful fact, preference, decision, or labeled inference.
dsh-assist 提供工具 assist_checkpoint：Save a checkpoint summary for this session only.
dsh-assist 提供工具 assist_recall：Search current-role long-term memory; an empty query returns recent entries.
dsh-assist 提供工具 assist_resume：Explicitly copy an unexpired checkpoint from another session with the same role.
dsh-assist 提供工具 assist_revise：Replace the text of an existing current-role memory without deleting it.
dsh-assist 提供工具 assist_idle_start：Explicitly opt in to idle follow-ups only at the user request. Remember this session opt-in for restart recovery.
dsh-assist 提供工具 assist_idle_stop：Stop idle follow-ups and forget the saved opt-in for this primary session.
dsh-assist 提供工具 assist_idle_status：Return the idle follow-up status for this primary agent.

dsh-assist README · English：Turn a Harness conversation into a reusable AI companion: choose a persona, retain useful memories, and let it start a brief conversation after a period of inactivity.

> **Preview release.** Targets Harness Desktop **0.2.1-rc.3**. Offline tests pass. Windows Desktop installation/loading was verified for v0.3.0; v0.3.1 keeps the same runtime. Real-model proactive chat and the revised voice remain unverified. This is an independent community project, not an official DeepSeek product.

dsh-assist README · What is new in v0.3.1?：**A more natural voice for the default fish daughter.** Replies can end naturally, without a routine follow-up question or service menu. The persona uses fewer stock affectionate phrases and includes short dialogue examples. Opt-in idle chat and restart recovery from v0.3.0 remain available.

dsh-assist README · What is new in v0.3.1?：[Download the plugin](https://github.com/a740411040/dsh-assist/releases/tag/v0.3.1) · [Install and enable](docs/DESKTOP.md) · [Send trial feedback](https://github.com/a740411040/dsh-assist/issues/new?template=trial-feedback.md)

dsh-assist README · What is new in v0.3.1?：We are looking for early testers on **Windows + Harness Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3**. Tell us where installation, activation, restart recovery, or stopping worked or failed. The [one-minute trial](docs/IDLE.md) helps collect reproducible results; model calls use your normal quota. No need to share private conversations or memory files.

dsh-assist README · What it does：| Capability | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Portable personas | Versioned JSON packs with identity, voice, greeting, and memory guidance |
| Persistent memory | Long-term notes shared within a persona; short-term checkpoints scoped to a session |
| Proactive chat | Opt-in idle triggers with cooldowns, quiet hours, and an unanswered-message limit |
| Shareable packs | Public exports omit stored memories; private backups require an explicit option |
| Inspectable data | Local JSON storage, CLI tools, and documented formats |

dsh-assist README · Meet the default companion：**Rice-Loving Chubby Fish Daughter** — **爱吃白饭的大肥鱼女儿** — is a playful fictional fish who loves a bowl of plain steamed rice. She calls you “爸爸” (“Dad”) by default; you can change that address at any time. The bundled persona speaks Chinese by default; ask for another language if preferred.

> “Dad, I'm here.”

dsh-assist README · Meet the default companion：Her voice is meant to be brief and conversational: no routine follow-up questions or service menus, and no obligatory rice jokes or affectionate catchphrases. Questions are welcome when the conversation actually needs one. The examples guide the tone; they are not fixed replies.

dsh-assist README · Meet the default companion：**Availability:** The v0.3.1 downloads include the updated persona, selected automatically when initializing fresh storage. Existing installations retain their saved roles and memories; see [how to try the updated persona](docs/DESKTOP.md#默认角色与已有安装).

dsh-assist README · Installation：The commands below use **Windows PowerShell**. Desktop supplies its own runtime; a separate system Node.js/npm installation is not required for plugin installation.

dsh-assist README · Installation：1. Launch Harness Desktop once to initialize its profile. Use **Manage dsh Command…** in the application menu to install or repair its `dsh` command.
2. **Fully quit Desktop.** Closing the window may only hide it.
3. Open a new PowerShell terminal. Verify that `dsh` comes from Desktop and reports `0.2.1-rc.3`, then install the downloaded package:

```powershell
Get-Command dsh
dsh --version

$package = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads\dsh-assist-0.3.1.tgz'

dsh-assist README · Installation：Adjust the path if your download is elsewhere. Stop if a command fails. Reopen Desktop after installation.

An npm-installed standalone `dsh` cannot modify Desktop's profile. See the [installation and troubleshooting guide](docs/DESKTOP.md) for source-folder installation and existing-user migration.

dsh-assist README · Enable proactive chat：In the target conversation, ask:

> Use `assist_list`, select `little-fish` with `assist_use`, and read `assist_memory_read`. Then call `assist_idle_start`: chat after 15 idle minutes, wait at least 30 minutes between triggers, pause after two unanswered triggers, and stay quiet from 23:00 to 08:00.

**Enabled means the tool returned `enabled: true`**, not merely that the model said it would remind you.

dsh-assist README · Enable proactive chat：| Action | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| Enable or change settings | `assist_idle_start` |
| Inspect this conversation | `assist_idle_status` |
| Stop future triggers | `assist_idle_stop` |

dsh-assist README · Enable proactive chat：Quiet hours use the backend's local timezone. The backend must remain running; saved opt-ins resume when the original session is loaded after restart, after a fresh idle/cooldown wait. New sessions stay off. Stop also forgets the saved opt-in. Each trigger uses the selected model and incurs normal usage. Stop does not retract a turn already submitted.

dsh-assist README · Enable proactive chat：For a one-minute check, use `idleMinutes: 1`, `cooldownMinutes: 1`, `maxUnanswered: 1`, `quietStart: 0`, and `quietEnd: 0`. After the model finishes replying, stop typing. A trigger should occur after roughly 60–75 seconds; the response itself also depends on model latency. No second trigger should occur until you reply. Then call `assist_idle_stop`.

dsh-assist README · Enable proactive chat：See [idle-chat settings](docs/IDLE.md) for full behavior. Reading [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) in TRAE or another tool does not, by itself, supply a running Harness timer. This package does not connect to QQ, WeChat, or X.

dsh-assist README · Data and development：Memory lives in `DSH_ASSIST_HOME`, otherwise `DSH_HOME/dsh-assist`, or `~/.dsh/dsh-assist` when neither variable is set. Public export filters stored memory fields; it does not redact personal information written into the persona itself.

Standalone CLI and development require **Node.js 20.18+**. Core and CLI need no third-party runtime dependencies.

```powershell
node src/cli.js init --home "$PWD\.work\demo"
npm test
npm run check
npm run release
dsh-assist README · Data and development：The release script builds local artifacts only. It does not publish to GitHub or npm.

dsh-assist README · Documentation：This README is bilingual. The detailed guides are currently in Simplified Chinese.

以下为 **Windows PowerShell** 步骤。桌面端自带运行环境，安装插件无需另行安装系统 Node.js/npm。

1. 先启动一次 Harness Desktop，完成 profile 初始化；在应用菜单的 **Manage dsh Command…** 中安装或修复桌面端命令。
2. **完全退出桌面端**，只关闭窗口可能仍在后台运行。
3. 打开新 PowerShell，确认 `dsh` 来自桌面端且版本为 `0.2.1-rc.3`，再安装：

dsh-assist README · 下载与安装：```powershell
Get-Command dsh
dsh --version

$package = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads\dsh-assist-0.3.1.tgz'

下载到其他位置时修改路径；命令报错时先处理错误。确认安装后重新打开应用。
不要使用全局 npm 安装的另一个 `dsh` 修改 desktop profile。

源码目录安装、已有用户切换人设和故障排查见 [安装指南](docs/DESKTOP.md)。

dsh-assist README · 开启、查询与关闭主动聊天：在目标会话中发送：

> 请先调用 assist_list，用 assist_use 切换到 little-fish，再调用 assist_memory_read。
> 然后调用 assist_idle_start：空闲 15 分钟后主动聊天，两次至少间隔 30 分钟，连续两次没人回复就暂停，23:00–08:00 不打扰。

**只有工具返回 `enabled: true` 才算开启**，模型口头说“已开启”不代表计时器已经运行。

| 操作 | 工具 |
| --- | --- |
| 开启或修改设置 | `assist_idle_start` |
| 查询当前会话 | `assist_idle_status` |
| 停止未来触发 | `assist_idle_stop` |

安静时段按后端本地时区计算。**应用后端必须保持运行**；已启用的原会话重新加载后会恢复，重新等待空闲与冷却；新会话仍需首次启用。停止会同时删除保存的启用状态。每次触发产生正常模型用量，停止不会撤回已提交的回合。

dsh-assist README · 开启、查询与关闭主动聊天：一分钟体验可设为 `idleMinutes: 1`、`cooldownMinutes: 1`、`maxUnanswered: 1`、`quietStart: 0`、`quietEnd: 0`。等回复完成后停止输入，约 60–75 秒应触发一个模型回合，实际回复还取决于模型速度。你再次回复前不应有第二次触发；体验后调用 `assist_idle_stop`。

完整参数见 [主动聊天说明](docs/IDLE.md)。只让 TRAE 等工具读取 [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)，不会自动获得 Harness 计时与唤醒能力。本包不连接 QQ、微信或 X。
